roles_method: All 81,396 taker rows matched as a multiset on transaction_hash, token_id, side, rounded size and price to activity. Remaining trade activity records classified maker. Counts are API trade records, not orders or individual onchain logs.
turnover_method: Sum activity usdc_size for trade records; 22 SELL records have negligible weight. Buy cash uses usdc_size including charged fees. Merge/redemption amounts are collateral returned, not profit.
clock_method: 222 matched LoL Game N markets; GRID recorded gameClock.currentSeconds with ticking extrapolation from received_at_utc; exclude anchors older than 60s and non-live/finished states. Approximate observed minutes, not exact seconds; received timestamps include feed delay. 61,018 classified trade records and 396 excluded. Do not extrapolate this timing evidence to CS2 round timing.
warning: Pair averaged buy prices are reconstructed across the entire market; below-$1 combined averages do not prove simultaneous risk-free arbitrage. Gross market buying is cumulative recycled turnover, not peak stake.
